function.decides: makes a governed decision (a state change, an approval) and records it
function.exchanges: carries data between this system and another, in an agreed format
function.monitors: shows the system's state as it changes, without changing it
function.serves: answers requests from people or other systems
function.ingests: takes data in from outside and stores it
function.transforms: turns data from one form into another as its main job
function.schedules: runs work at set times or in a set order
function.notifies: tells people or systems that something happened
function.provisions: creates and configures the resources and identities others use
function.reports: produces summaries or documents from stored data

method.enforces: a rule holds because the platform refuses the alternative, not only because code checks it
method.signs: attaches a cryptographic signature a reader verifies
method.verifies: checks a signature or chain against a trusted record
method.certifies: a named authority vouches for a component, recorded in a ledger
method.partitions: splits data so each part has exactly one set of writers
method.replicates: keeps copies in sync across processes or hosts
method.translates: converts between formats (XML to JSON, one schema to another)
method.validates: checks data against a schema before use
method.funnels: sends every call of one kind through a single module
method.queues: puts work on a queue for another process to take
method.caches: keeps a copy of results to answer later requests faster
method.isolates: runs work in a separate process or sandbox so a failure stays there
method.dispatches: sends a request to run named work on another process or host, which runs it
method.watches: reacts to changes in a store or stream as they happen
method.batches: groups many items into one operation
method.retries: repeats a failed operation under a stated rule

feature.audit-trail: every decision, accepted or refused, is kept and verifiable
feature.fail-closed: when the authority is missing or stale, nothing is decided
feature.per-identity-access: each person or system acts under its own identity and rights
feature.idempotent-writes: repeating a write leaves the same result
feature.offline-tolerant: keeps working when a remote part is unreachable
feature.live-view: shows changes to the people watching as they happen
feature.schema-checked: data is checked against a published schema at the boundary
feature.reproducible-runs: the same inputs give the same outputs, run to run
feature.checked: the project runs its own test, probe or script that checks this property — it is tested, which is not the same as enforced
